properties.notes: Traditional stone building within the town centre that had been home to Alnwick library for many years. Now vacant following the relocation of the library to Alnwick Playhouse in 2019. Although not listed, the building is still of heritage significance, and retention is preferred. Dating from 1810, the building had originally been a school until 1921 before being utilised as the library for the town. Available for redevelopment and conversion is considered the most appropriate approach. A proposal for part demolition, alteration, conversion and extension to 4 homes now permitted (19/00078/FUL). Now classified as a small site in the SHLAA.
